# NEX4

NEX4 is an independent digital studio based in Malaysia. We bring development and marketing together to build practical digital experiences for businesses.

## Services

- Web development: landing pages, business websites, web applications and dashboards.
- Mobile applications: cross-platform applications, API integrations and AI integrations.
- Digital marketing: social media, content strategy, campaigns and brand presence.

## Live products

- MyNutriTrack AI: https://nutritrack.nex4.my
- NEX4 Marketing CRM public beta: https://crm.nex4.my
